decisions.reason: The decision changes the physical position of the I2C series resistors but does not change any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment or the candidate GPIO pool.
Placing the series resistors at the ESP32-S3 pins does not alter the interboard signal connector, its pin count, or its SDA0/SCL0 pinout.
The source decision concerns I2C signal conditioning and does not affect the separate interboard power connector or its pin-order rule.
The I2C series-resistor placement has no effect on the native USB D+ and D- data-line requirement.
The resistor-position decision does not change the standalone USB power regulator, activation condition, powered rail, loads, or source-selection behavior.
Moving I2C series resistors within the circuit does not change the three-board architecture or the roles of the main and sensor boards.
The source decision concerns SDA/SCL conditioning and does not change the GPIO5-controlled 5V rail, its pull-down, loads, or operating behavior.
The I2C resistor topology does not affect the addressable LED supply, level shifting, data interface, or 5V shutdown behavior.
The source decision does not change the sensor board's role as a connector hub; shared involvement of I2C devices is incidental.
The 22-ohm I2C series-resistor position is unrelated to the charge-status LED connector and its 270-ohm R6 resistor.
The source decision does not change the AXP2101 power-management IC, required rails, normal-operation source, or battery power path.
The I2C series-resistor placement does not affect DCDC1 output voltage, current rating, or its role as the normal 3.3V source.
